text: The core objective of management is to address the issues of efficiency and effectiveness in organizational operations. Whether it is a business, a government agency, a non-profit organization, or a public institution, all need to optimize processes, enhance performance, and adapt to changes through management. Its research scope includes the integration of resources such as "people, finance, materials, information, and time", as well as the implementation of management functions such as "planning, organizing, leading, controlling, and innovating".
